purpose: Classify a bounded set of literal slots in the same previously observed script against fixed public test/program vocabularies, without executing it, printing unknown values or reading referenced paths.

retained_read_guards: No symlink; lstat regular file; nlink 1.
Open read-only with the previous NOFOLLOW/CLOEXEC/NONBLOCK flags.
Before/opened/after inode, device, size, mtime, ctime and mode comparison.
Full exact expected size and SHA-256 before parsing.
Strict UTF-8 plus warnings-as-errors ast.parse; only fixed failure enums/type and source position, never exception messages/source lines.
No target import, eval, exec, runpy, subprocess, referenced path access or filesystem traversal.

binary_assignment.name: binary
binary_assignment.shape: Exactly one unambiguously assigned top-level binary at line7/column0/end-line7, value pathlib.Path with exactly one str Constant and zero keywords; otherwise fixed rejection.

command_assignment.name: cmd
command_assignment.shape: Exactly one unambiguously assigned top-level cmd at line8/column0/end-line8, value ast.List of exactly 10 direct slots and no starred element; otherwise fixed rejection.

command_use.shape: Exactly one syntactic subprocess.run in the module at line10/end-line10, one positional Name('cmd'), exactly cwd/stdout/stderr keywords; keyword values are not followed or exported.

allowed_ast_scope.binding_checks: Count only stores/deletes/import aliases and common declaration/rebinding forms for binary/cmd/pathlib/subprocess/str; require unique unaliased original pathlib/subprocess imports, one binary and cmd assignment, no str shadowing and no watched-attribute mutation. This is deliberately syntax evidence, not complete Python dataflow.
allowed_ast_scope.line7_path_output: The single accepted str Constant is classified by startswith('/') into static_absolute_literal_omitted or static_relative_literal_omitted. Every other binary-assignment shape is rejected; no path contents, basename, components, length, hash or OS lookup.
allowed_ast_scope.line8_output: Exactly 10 ordered entries containing slot index and one fixed classification enum. Known frozen-case matches may add a 1-based case ordinal. Never output source-derived token text.
allowed_ast_scope.other_nodes: No string-constant values outside the fixed line7 argument and the direct 10 line8 slots are read for this classification. No environment dictionaries, formatting, concatenation, Name resolution or unknown callee arguments are inspected.

fixed_command_literal_dictionary.interpretation_limit: These enum labels identify exact literals only. Position alone does not prove argument parsing, actual binary identity, successful execution or effective privilege.

frozen_test_dictionary.comparison: Exact whole-string equality to the existing parents array; no substring, case folding, normalization, unescaping beyond ordinary ast.Constant parsing, regex, shortened names or fuzzy search.
frozen_test_dictionary.output: root29_case_match plus the original list's stable 1-based ordinal; never an unrecognized argument value.

fixed_expression_dictionary.binary_reference: Only ast.Call(func=Name('str'), args=[Name('binary')], keywords=[]) at a direct cmd slot with the required line7 assignment. Emit pinned_binary_reference_syntax. No evaluation.

unknown_literal_policy.env_policy: Environment assignments are not parsed into names or values and receive the same unknown-literal enum unless they exactly equal one of the predeclared non-environment tokens.

assessment.selector_condition: One direct pinned_binary_reference_syntax slot precedes exactly one exact original Root29 case match, and a known --exact flag occurs after that binary-reference slot.
assessment.selector_positive_meaning: This source declares a reference to binary followed by a known original CI test selection. This is bounded syntax evidence for test intent only.
assessment.selector_negative_meaning: No qualifying frozen selector was found. This does not prove that the file is unrelated, non-fixture, ordinary production, absent or unauthorized.
assessment.missing_or_ambiguous_shape: Return fixed shape_mismatch/ambiguous_binding status and unknown purpose; do not broaden the parser or read more files.

preparation_checks: Preserve the seven original safe read/identity helpers and warning-safe parser except only the necessary projection change.
Assert the exact 29-name list, order and inventory blob while embedding the lookup table.
Use synthetic in-memory AST inputs only to cover allowed flags/case ordinal/binary-reference shape and unknown token redaction; these are inspector correctness checks, not H execution.
All expected source identity nanosecond values are copied as decimal strings or original exact Python integers; never use a JavaScript Number round-trip.
An eventual wrapper/request must use a new evidence path and independent key, after Root freezes it; v2 artifacts remain immutable.

static_negative_matrix.input: A different file hash, inode or before/after identity
line8 list with 9 or 11 slots; a starred element; dynamic list construction
Unknown command/path/env/argv literal including a secret-shaped value
static_negative_matrix.required: Only unknown_literal_omitted; no value, length, name, prefix or hash.

static_negative_matrix.input: An almost-equal, prefixed, suffixed or shortened Root29 case name
A known case literal outside the direct line8 list
static_negative_matrix.required: Ignored, no search of arbitrary source strings.

static_negative_matrix.input: A known case and --exact without direct str(binary) linkage
An unknown expression using binary indirectly or through formatting/concatenation
A syntax warning or parser error
static_negative_matrix.required: Warning-as-error path with safe error category/position only.
No target or referenced-file execution and no authority/runtime/ordinary acceptance claim.

source_delta.expected_time_change: Only the two expected nanosecond constants change from exact Python integers to exact decimal strings; main converts the same read_stable_source integer fields to strings before full expected identity comparison and output. No JS numeric round-trip.
source_delta.projection_change: Remove the broad prior shape projection and replace it with the approved fixed line7/line8/line10 classification. Add the exact pinned 29-name immutable lookup and fixed program/flag dictionaries.
source_delta.main_change: Update schema/prior-result pin/limitations, copy only the closed projection assessment, retain all authority/custody/runtime-proof fields as false.

static_checks.kind: V8 mirror and exact-text static checks only
static_checks.helper_comparison_domain: Full text from each original def header through the next top-level def boundary.
static_checks.proof_limit: The V8 mirror exercises exact lookup/output logic only; it is not Python parsing, execution, a formal interpreter equivalence proof, or a run against the real target.

handoff: Root reviews the complete fixed script and independently prepares any new wrapper, current-worktree source pin, evidence directory and request key. Do not reuse or alter the frozen v2 request. No dispatch is authorized to this reviewer.
